pairs.question: Si quis pater familias liberis suis a servo interfectis, uxore occisa, incensa domo supplicium de servo non quam acerbissumum sumpserit, utrum is clemens ac misericors an inhumanissimus et crudelissimus esse videatur?
pairs.answer: Mihi vero inportunus ac ferreus, qui non dolore et cruciatu nocentis suum dolorem cruciatumque lenierit.
pairs.derivation: Cicero explicitly poses the question with 'Etenim quaero, si quis...utrum...an...' and answers it himself. Dropped the framing speech-tag 'Etenim quaero' (narration of the asking) at the start; the question proper begins 'Si quis pater familias...' and ends at the utrum/an alternative '...esse videatur', normalized to a '?'. The answer is the immediately following self-supplied verdict 'Mihi vero inportunus ac ferreus...lenierit' (ending at its first full stop); the next sentence 'Sic nos in his hominibus...' turns to applying the analogy and is excluded.
